cohort: The study included 12 pregnant women diagnosed with eclampsia or severe pre-eclampsia managed at a tertiary care hospital in Eluru, West Godavari District Andhra Pradesh, India.
finding: The study found that most cases involved young primigravida women (20-25 years old) with suboptimal antenatal care, where gestational hypertension preceding eclampsia was mostly diagnosed at 28-37 weeks, and maternal complications occurred in 33% but with no maternal deaths.
mod_finding: After diagnosis of eclampsia, 83% of the cases delivered by emergency caesarean.
birth_weight: Among the liveborn babies, 75% had birthweight >=1.5 kg.
gest_age: Gestational age at eclampsia onset was predominantly 28-37 weeks (58%).
